test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. B sits second to the left of D. E is an immediate neighbour of B. A sits to the immediate left of B. C sits second to the right of D. F sits to the immediate left of C. What is the position of A with respect to C?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the centre.

B sits second to the left of D.

E is an immediate neighbour of B.

A sits to the immediate left of B.

C sits second to the right of D.

F sits to the immediate left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c093a3fa2c01978c571ea4c527a37fec1c5bde9c96817e666b180694565b8edb.png] 

→ A is immediately to the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
